name: besonc
description: BESONC — Multi-Vendor Delivery & Logistics App for Cape Coast, Ghana

scripts.build: pnpm run build:nest && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:nest: for app in api-gateway auth-service user-service customer-bff catalogue-service pricing-service order-service payment-service media-service; do npx tsc -p apps/$app/tsconfig.json --rootDir . && echo "$app OK"; done
scripts.dev:stop: pkill -f 'ts-node.*apps/' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'nx start' 2>/dev/null; echo 'BESONC dev stopped.'
scripts.dev:mobile:ip: echo 'Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL before running, e.g.:' && echo '  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://192.168.1.42:3000 pnpm run dev:mobile'
scripts.db:migrate: for app in catalogue-service order-service payment-service media-service; do echo "--- $app ---"; if [ -f apps/$app/prisma/schema.prisma ]; then DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=apps/$app/prisma/schema.prisma; fi; done
scripts.db:generate: for app in catalogue-service order-service payment-service media-service; do echo "--- $app ---"; if [ -f apps/$app/prisma/schema.prisma ]; then DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL npx prisma generate --schema=apps/$app/prisma/schema.prisma; fi; done
scripts.db:seed:catalogue: DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL npx ts-node --transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register -P apps/catalogue-service/tsconfig.json prisma/seed-catalogue.ts
